10 استراض : see 4, in five places. ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) It (water) stagnated, or remained, or collected, in a place. (TA.) ―
-b3- And (assumed tropical:) It (a place, S, M, K) was, or became, wide, ample, or spacious. (S, M, Msb, K.) ―
-b4- And [hence (see its part. n. below)] استراضت النَّفْسُ (tropical:) The mind was, or became, dilated, free from straitness, cheerful, or happy. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
